training-communication.scope: Compare destination-specific exchange with gathering every input
training-communication.observation: Reuse the same two vectors for an exact split calculation, then lead to real uneven expert traffic and the return gradient path.

moe-routing.scope: Follow local expert parameters, native two-way exchange and matching gradients
moe-routing.observation: Two CPU/Gloo ranks dispatch and return fixed routes and preserve token identity. An independent serial oracle checks every output and gradient and rejects the wrong-order path.

k8s-autoscaling.scope: Trace actual resource metrics to desired, bound and available capacity
k8s-autoscaling.observation: Observe an owned kind HPA react to CPU, show a new Pod held unready while desired is two, then observe readiness and scale-down.

agent-sandbox.scope: Observe a real non-root container read and write boundary
agent-sandbox.observation: Both local executions produce a valid 37 report. Only the writable input mount allows mutation; independent host evidence rejects it and checks owned cleanup.
